caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of decorative floral fabric or wallpaper pattern. The design consists of intricate blue flowers, leaves, and branches scattered densely across a light, off-white background. The flowers and foliage vary in shape and size, with some large, detailed blossoms and others smaller and simpler. The main floral elements are filled with shades of blue, ranging from deep navy to light blue, and some areas appear to have white highlights or intricate dot and line detailing. Subtle curvilinear lines form a diamond mesh or grid in the background behind the floral pattern. On the right side of the composition, a barely visible vertical band features lighter, less saturated blue floral motifs, fading into the background, giving a sense of layering or a torn edge. The entire drawing sits on a plain, beige surface.
title: Quilted Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
